abstract: A rare case of germ cell tumor of the mediastinum infiltrating the lung and metastasizing to the supraclavicular lymph node in a 25-year-old male is presented. The patient presented with a history of superior vena cava syndrome and chest roentgenograms revealed an abnormal mediastinum. Primary positive diagnosis was made cytologically on sputum specimens. The peculiar cell type found in the Papanicolaou stained sputum smears were correlated with fine needle aspiration cytology of lung and lymph node, and confirmed the histologic pattern of the tumor metastasizing to the lymph node. To our knowledge, the present case is the first report of a primary mediastinal seminoma (germinoma) infiltrating the lung and diagnosed by sputum cytology. These results suggest the usefulness of sputum examination as an adjunctive diagnostic procedure in the detection of patients with possible lung infiltrated germinal neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 25歳男性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のまれな症例を報告します。患者は上大静脈症候群の既往があり、胸部X線写真で縦隔の異常が認められました。初回の確定診断は喀痰標本の細胞診で行われました。喀痰のパパニコロウ染色標本に見られた特徴的な細胞型は、肺とリンパ節の穿刺吸引細胞診と対比され、リンパ節転移の組織学的パターンと一致しました。我々の知る限り、本症例は肺に浸潤し喀痰細胞診で診断された原発性縦隔セミノーマ（ジャーミノーマ）の初めての報告です。これらの結果は、肺浸潤を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の検出において、喀痰検査が補助診断法として有用である可能性を示唆します。
